character.name: Idle
character.prompt: > Dark fantasy vampire, full body, feral and animalistic rather than elegant or aristocratic. Tall, lean and unnaturally muscular humanoid body with long limbs, slightly hunched posture and predatory proportions. Pale gray skin stretched tightly over the body, with visible veins, scars and patches of rough texture. The face should retain human traits but appear deeply corrupted: elongated jaw, pronounced cheekbones, sunken eyes, flattened or slightly bat-like nose, large pointed ears and a mouth filled with long sharp fangs. > > Completely unarmed. The vampire fights using claws, teeth, speed and supernatural strength. His hands should be slightly oversized with long, curved black claws, while the feet are elongated and animal-like, reinforcing a beastly silhouette. > > Wear only remnants of old dark clothing: torn trousers, shredded shirt fragments and pieces of a long coat or cloak hanging from the body. The clothes should look ancient, dirty and heavily damaged, as if they have survived years of hunting and transformation. No conventional armor. > > Add subtle bat-like characteristics without turning him into a literal bat creature: slightly extended forearms, stretched skin near the arms or torso, sharp shoulders and a silhouette reminiscent of a nocturnal predator. The posture should suggest that he can move both upright and in a low, stalking stance. > > The overall appearance should evoke classic gothic horror vampires mixed with a monstrous predator: intelligent enough to feel sinister, but physically closer to a beast than a nobleman. Dark gothic medieval aesthetic, muted black, gray, brown and dark crimson tones. No weapons, no large magical effects, no elegant jewelry or noble clothing. 16-bit pixel art RPG character, clear readable silhouette, detailed sprite, aggressive combat-ready pose.
